author: Brian Gordinier
text: Joe and his Valley Asphalt crew were incredible! Highly recommend! I recently wanted to expand my driveway and fix some cracks, so I called around for price quotes. Valley Asphalt was quick to respond, they had the lowest quote, and their service was excellent. They showed up on time, the crew were very professional and friendly, they did not damage my lawn while they worked, and their office manager Vicki followed up after to ask for feedback. Great experience all around from a great local family-owned company!

author: Mark D
text:
Joe and the entire Valley team did an amazing job on my asphalt driveway.
The Valley team was great and were plenty patient with all my questions.
Plenty of people warned me not to cheap out and to use the best....... and I am glad I did.

author: Frank Biondo
text: Construction around the house can be a challenge, and finding reliable contractors is even harder. But ever since I found Valley Asphalt, all my worries disappeared! Their prices are excellent, the product quality is top-notch, and their ethics are simply impeccable. Highly recommend!

author: M Yonko
text: Valley Asphalt & Sealing, Inc did a great job on our driveway.  Joe and his team took the time to understand want we wanted,  were careful with the existing plantings, finished the edges nicely and executed the job perfectly.  Highly recommend.

author: Paula Murphy
text: The crew at Valley Asphalt & Sealing is phenomenal! They are professional, hardworking, and incredibly polite. They arrive on time, execute their work efficiently, and leave the area spotless. It is hard to find a team this dedicated! Whether it be commercial or residential, they produce quality work that lasts for years! Highly recommend.
